headline: FIIs increase stakes in eight surging smallcap stocks in Q2
summary: Foreign institutional investors increased their shareholdings in eight smallcap stocks during the September 2026 quarter. These companies have delivered multibagger returns, surging over 200% in FY27 so far according to ACE Equity data. Kabra Extrusiontechnik led the gains with a 343% surge, followed by Modison at 333%. Retail investors tracking institutional flows can note growing foreign interest in select high-momentum smallcaps.
why_it_matters: FII buying validates smallcap momentum for retail investors
winners_losers: Smallcap shareholders gain / uninformed buyers risk chasing highs

headline: Kabra Extrusiontechnik reports a 1,084 percent jump in second-quarter profit
hook: New-energy division drives triple-digit earnings surge
summary: Kabra Extrusiontechnik posted a massive 1,084 percent increase in profit after tax for the second quarter, driven by strong performance in its new-energy division. The company manufactures plastic extrusion machinery and battery packs for electric vehicles through its Battrix division. Retail investors tracking niche green energy plays will note the rapid scaling of its EV battery business. Sustained profitability in the new-energy segment could rerate valuations for the micro-cap manufacturer.
whats_next: Watch third-quarter results to confirm new-energy margin sustainability
why_it_matters: EV division scaling validates green energy pivot for small-cap holders
